role: String catalog localizing the iOS Info.plist purpose strings into 16 languages plus English.
toplevel: sourceLanguage en, version 1.0. Entries: CFBundleName (en only, value 'Emuqu', state new), and NSBluetoothAlways/NSHealthShare/NSHealthUpdate/NSLocationWhenInUse/NSMicrophone/NSMotion/NSPhotoLibraryAdd/NSSpeechRecognition UsageDescription, each with 17 localizations (ar da de en es fi fr is it ja ko nb nl pt-BR ru sv zh-Hans), every non-English unit state 'translated', English state 'new'. English values are byte-identical to Emuqu/Info.plist; sampled de/fr/ja translations carry the current content (Rouvy, physical effort, Settings -> Wearables export switches, street names for the assistant). Copied into the app bundle by the Emuqu Resources phase (pbxproj 3615). Correction: the CFBundleName entry is not a leftover. It is Xcode's extraction of the CFBundleName that GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE injects from PRODUCT_NAME, marked shouldTranslate false.
